deviation.message: Phase-2 preamble committed green rather than red. Plan-37 is a structural refactor (service-layer extraction) with no new observable behavior; integration tests of worker-init/worker-finish were already green against the existing thick commands. Tests retained as behavioral-equivalence guard for tasks 2-5.

comment.message: De-risk draft ready for review (commit 65299e6). WorkflowService.initializeWorker implemented; WorkerInitCommand reduced to thin shell. 69 tests pass; workflow package coverage 93% — hardening pass will lift to 95% and address the catch-Exception path.

deviation.message: Order deviation: de-risking tasks 2, 3, 4 first, then a single combined hardening pass. Rationale: structural refactor with cross-cutting concerns (exception model, wiring pattern, test style) shared across all three migrations. Seeing the full shape of WorkflowService before hardening lets us harden consistently. Task 2 left in de-risked state until tasks 3 and 4 de-risk passes complete.

deviation.message: Hardening 2 (IFactory / single-service wiring) deferred. WorkflowServiceImpl is cheap to construct and holds no per-call state; the three command call sites use a one-line idiom. Adding IFactory would either break every existing per-command test (which constructs commands via no-arg new) or introduce setter-injection that adds surface area without solving a measured problem. Defer until a future plan needs cross-command state or a real DI motivation.
